description:
Goal
Make compiler2 native codegen consume the settled native return/continuation ABI directly, so tuple-field return delivery into quicksort continuations uses the exact shape chosen upstream.

Problem being fixed
The quicksort native JIT crash is not a closure-capture flattening bug. The continuation closure for `qsort__e9__resume_1` is built correctly. The failure happens earlier: `partition__clause_0` returns into that continuation using a one-value ABI even though the callee return contract is `TupleFields([ValueRef, ValueRef])`.

Verified failure
- `cargo test compiler2_native_program_jit_runs_quicksort_through_compiler2_codegen --lib -- --nocapture`
- `target/debug/fz2 --log-telemetry /tmp/fz2-quicksort.telemetry.jsonl run fixtures2/00020_quicksort_jit_entry.fz`
- Runtime panic: `fz_closure_get_capture_i64 closure: ExpectedTag { expected: ValueKind(4), found: ValueKind(0) }`

Root cause
- `NativeBody.return_abi` carries the authoritative delivered return contract: for `partition`, `ReturnAbi::TupleFields([ValueRef, ValueRef])`.
- `NativeBody.return_lane_reprs` is derived from `return_layout.abi_reprs()`, which describes the physical layout of the returned tuple object and is `[ValueRef]` for a tuple value.
- Native codegen has a local decision engine (`NativeDemandAbi::returned_shape`, `tuple_field_arity`, and related helpers) that reconstructs delivered shape from `return_lane_reprs`.
- That local reconstruction chooses `DeliveredShape::Value(ValueRef)`, so `partition__clause_0` emits `cont(tuple_value, self)` while `qsort__e9__resume_1` expects `cont(low, high, self)`. The continuation self argument is then garbage, and the first closure capture read panics.

Design rule
- Return delivery shape flows down from `ReturnAbi`; codegen must not rediscover it from type/layout/lane side channels.
- `return_lane_reprs` may only survive if it has a sharply named non-delivery purpose. It must not decide return shape.
- The local decision-engine functions should become tripwires while callers are migrated, then be deleted in the cleanup sweep.

Code seams
- `src/compiler2/native_codegen/demand.rs`
- native codegen return-shape helpers in `driver.rs`, `function.rs`, and `terminator.rs`
- native lowering only if `return_lane_reprs` can be removed or renamed without widening this ticket beyond the return delivery seam

Checks
- targeted unit/codegen tests that prove tuple-field return contracts use `ReturnAbi`, not `return_lane_reprs`
- `cargo test compiler2_native_program_jit_runs_quicksort_through_compiler2_codegen --lib`
- no `fz_closure_get_capture_i64` runtime panic
- dump/telemetry for quicksort shows `partition` returning two fields into `qsort__e9__resume_1`
title: Compiler2 native quicksort uses stale local return-shape inference
